verdict.rationale: Infrastructure Manager lets users define infrastructure declaratively with Terraform, which supports keeping automation as versionable code. Its preview deployments let users review how changes affect infrastructure before applying them. That covers the versioning and review parts of the story, but nothing in the pack shows a rollback path. Missing for 10: documented rollback or revert to prior deployment revisions, explicit revision/version history for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
